world.eraEvidence: Ellie vanishes in May 2005; the story returns ten years later, in 2015
world.setting: A small American suburban town; a family home, a cafe, a library, a woodland edge, a basement behind a locked door
world.register: Restrained psychological thriller, told as a gallery of portraits; no graphic harm to any child

laurel.name: Laurel
laurel.role: Ellie's mother; she takes Floyd and Poppy as replacements for her daughter
laurel.look: Laurel Mack, a woman in her late forties, slim, shoulder-length greying brown hair, a plain cardigan and jeans, American suburban, 2015

ellie.name: Ellie
ellie.role: Laurel's daughter, fifteen in May 2005; she walks to the library and does not come back
ellie.look: Ellie Mack, a fifteen-year-old girl, slim, long straight brown hair, school jumper and jeans, American teen, 2005

hanna.name: Hanna
hanna.role: Ellie's older sister, who stayed; she keeps the flat and the key
hanna.look: Hanna Mack, a woman in her twenties, tall, dark hair in a low bun, a dark coat, American, 2015

floyd.name: Floyd
floyd.role: The man Laurel meets in the cafe; the one the reader misjudges
floyd.look: Floyd Dunn, a man in his late forties, broad, short greying hair, an open-neck shirt and a waxed jacket, American, 2015

poppy.name: Poppy
poppy.role: Floyd's daughter, nine years old, home-schooled; she lets Laurel pretend
poppy.look: Poppy, a nine-year-old girl, small and slight, dark-blonde ponytail, a blue cardigan, American child, 2015

noel.name: Noel
noel.role: Ellie's former tutor, Floyd's dismissed girlfriend; she is kept in the basement
noel.look: Noel Donnelly, a young woman in her twenties in 2005, slim, light hair tied back, a heavy khaki waterproof coat, American, 2005

theo.name: Theo
theo.role: Ellie's boyfriend in 2005; ten years on he is with Hanna
theo.look: Theo Goodman, a tall lanky young man, short dark hair, a hoodie, American, 2005

paul.name: Paul
paul.role: Laurel's former husband and Hanna's father; the one who answered
paul.look: Paul Mack, a man in his fifties, balding, a heavy build, a polo shirt, American, 2015

kitchen.look: The Mack family kitchen: a wooden table, a sink under the window, plain cupboards; the house where Laurel leaves cash on the table

cafe.look: A sunlit cafe with small round tables and a counter, where Laurel meets Floyd after the funeral

bedroom.look: Ellie's bedroom, kept untouched for ten years

library.look: A small town library with shelves and reading tables; Ellie walks here in May

woodland.look: The woodland edge where a bag of bones is left

street.look: A suburban street; Laurel runs into Noel here

basement.look: Noel's basement behind a locked door

floydTable.look: Floyd's dining table, where Poppy sits before Laurel

hannaFlat.look: Hanna's small flat with its front door and the key

spine.claim: Ellie walks to the library in May 2005 and never comes back, and nobody searches for her; each person holds a replacement for her.
Laurel takes Floyd and Poppy as replacements, Hanna keeps the flat and the key, and Theo moves on to her.
Laurel learns that the girl at Floyd's table is Ellie's child, and the copy stops being a comfort.
Floyd's past comes out: Noel's basement, the locked door, the child, and the letter that shows why he chose Laurel.
Laurel could not touch Ellie's room for ten years; she ends by making a bed for Ellie's daughter, one image of healing or the last substitution.
